events.title: Debutant striker Stan Collymore scores a hat-trick for 레스터 시티 in their 5–2 win over 선덜랜드 in the Premier League, just days after his transfer from 애스턴 빌라 .

리버풀 pay a club record £11 million for 레스터 시티 striker Emile Heskey .

Ajax appoints Hans Westerhof as caretaker-manager after the resignation of 얀 바우터르스 .

Gerard van der Lem resigns as manager of AZ

맨체스터 유나이티드 are now looking all set for title glory as they head the table by a seven-point margin with 리즈 유나이티드 as their closest rivals. 리버풀, 첼시 and 아스널 are looking more and more distant a threat in the race to prevent the Premier League trophy from remaining at Old Trafford . At the other end of the table, 셰필드 웬즈데이 and 왓퍼드 are looking doomed, with 브래드퍼드 시티 occupying the final relegation position and 더비 카운티 hovering dangerously close to the drop zone. The race for Premier League football next season is headed by 찰턴 애슬레틱 and 입스위치 타운. 반즐리, 맨체스터 시티, 허더즈필드 타운 and 버밍엄 시티 complete the top six.
